isolation: Two actual atlas modules compiled from frozen source bytes with separate module namespaces. Each owns its real RasterCache. Portrait-fit is duplicated per namespace, with identical source bytes and independent FittedPortraitCache instances. Other body and scratch-canvas dependencies resolve through the same current src/client directory.
scope: Exact CPU Canvas correctness and actual cache reuse only. Complete original RGBA (including transparent RGB), crop, final entry output and untimed cache/source-read counts. No rendering-time or game-memory claim; no WebGL context, renderer, simulation, benchmark or per-frame observer.
method: Actual isolated before/candidate atlas draws only. Full original source getImageData is observed during each real cache miss, including world shadows. Native crop sources, exact drawImage arguments and entire final Canvas RGBA are hashed without tolerance. Cached draws resolve to their previously observed original source; they are checked against a fresh original-provider source for that exact input. No direct standalone painter substitutes or performance timing.
limitations: Finite declared matrix, not all possible custom painters or input combinations.
FittedPortraitCache has no public miss counter; real portrait misses are its observed full-domain source reads, cross-checked with entry deltas in two-call non-evicting groups.
Observers add readbacks, hashing and task yields; this is correctness/cache-reuse evidence, not performance or process-memory measurement.
Stock source-key sharing does not prove WebGL, simulation, event timing, release sockets or picking.

Each provider cache is cleared per group and at completion. Evidence retains only hashes/counts/metadata; observed source/crop/output byte arrays and fixture output canvases are released after each step.
